plain.source:
using Microsoft.Win32;
class P { void M() { Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(k); } }

implicit-new-key.source:
using Microsoft.Win32;
class P { RegistryKey k = new(); }

using-static.source:
using static Microsoft.Win32.Registry;
class P { void M() { var k = CurrentUser; } }
using-static.limit: a bare static property used as a value (not a call, not a member-access target) is not attributed to a `using static` type

using-static-member-access.source:
using static Microsoft.Win32.Registry;
class P { void M() { CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(k); } }

method-handler.source:
using Microsoft.Win32;
class P { object M() => Registry.CurrentUser.GetValue(k); }
